name: isNonHumanIdentityInventoryEnabled
definition: True when JumpCloud's complete service-account inventory holds at least one service account, so machine identities are inventoried separately from human admins' API keys. False when the complete inventory is empty.
population: service accounts returned by GET /api/v2/service-accounts, read completely against totalCount
evidenceRequiredForTrue: a complete service-account list holding at least one service account

changeLog.change: Registered at V0 so the registry gate can fail push runs on main; proposed, single emitter. Presence of an inventory, not its completeness.
